evidence_boundary: Wang et al. directly measure acceptance-limited RPA energy-per-charge distributions and probe fluctuations, while the two-point phase map cannot uniquely identify a true wave number or exclude unresolved ion-acoustic activity. Their two-dimensional axisymmetric electrostatic WarpX case is a representative kinetic reference rather than a point-by-point experimental reconstruction; passive cohorts are one-way coupled and collisionless, and the full, mean, frozen and fluctuation-only fields are sensitivity controls rather than additive acceleration channels. Kelly et al. report new gamma-scattering and neutron-transfer experiments combined with historical electron and proton scattering; spectroscopic factors remain ADWA and optical-model dependent, one historical local proton cross section is digitized from a published figure, and model agreement in summed M1 strength follows conventional quenching or fitted couplings rather than successful state-by-state structure prediction. No WarpX, signal-processing, FRESCO, ADWA or nuclear-structure calculation was rerun locally.
